# 7 — The City of Light

> A simulated global "quantum computer" made of every connected device on
> Earth — and eventually in space — working as one machine. This repo holds
> the mythic/conceptual spec plus per-device engineering specs; each device
> spec is implemented as real software in a separate repo.

## Docs

- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the conceptual/mythic spec — what 7 is, its origin,
  form, and function.
- [specs/INDEX.md](specs/INDEX.md): index and conventions for per-device
  engineering specs.
- [specs/muon_detector/SPEC.md](specs/muon_detector/SPEC.md): first device
  spec — a real-world cosmic-ray muon detector as a physical sensory input
  node. In progress: built against an archived CosmicWatch v3X baseline.
- [specs/muon_detector/DESIGN_LEDGER.md](specs/muon_detector/DESIGN_LEDGER.md):
  decision ledger tracking what's decided, proposed, or blocked against the
  archived hardware baseline.
- [specs/muon_detector/input/SOURCE_INDEX.md](specs/muon_detector/input/SOURCE_INDEX.md):
  provenance and contents of the full pinned upstream CosmicWatch v3X repo
  (Gerbers, schematic, BOM spreadsheets, firmware, datasheets) fetched into
  `input/upstream/`, plus CSV extractions of the BOM spreadsheets in
  `input/extracted/`.
- [specs/personal_quantum_computer/SPEC.md](specs/personal_quantum_computer/SPEC.md):
  second device spec — a residential compute node establishing the
  distributed, small-nodes-everywhere pattern; hardware approach
  intentionally left open.
- [creation.md](creation.md): reusable checklist/template for bootstrapping
  new repos in this same spec-driven style.

## Outputs

- [outputs/vision/index.html](outputs/vision/index.html): self-contained
  static WebGL page — first pass at the eventual City of Light
  visualization. Currently renders synthetic muon rain (random spawn
  timing, cos²(θ)-biased fall angle); see `specs/muon_detector/SPEC.md`'s
  "Visualization" section.
- [outputs/muon_detector/synthetic_source.py](outputs/muon_detector/synthetic_source.py)
  and [outputs/muon_detector/ingest_gateway.py](outputs/muon_detector/ingest_gateway.py):
  working, tested software for the muon detector's data plane — a
  synthetic event source matching the real CosmicWatch v3X text contract,
  and an ingestion gateway that normalizes it (or eventual real device
  output) into the `cosmicwatch.event.v1` JSON envelope.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): license and repo basics.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): full concatenated text of all docs above,
  for full-context LLM ingestion.
